purpose: Match the already bounded CPU smooth k(J) law and both coefficient-gradient pressure/acceleration terms on the private periodic GPU path, without an independent k history or another neighbour pass.
law: s0=1-n0; k_i=k0*exp((J_i-1)/(s0*Ck)); GJ_i=sum_j(V0*J_j*(J_j-J_i)*C_i*grad(W_ij)); Gk_i=k_i*GJ_i/(s0*Ck). Retain exact k0 and J=1 branches and reject nonrepresentable positive-k states instead of clamping.
step: Use current k_i in diffusion bounds and the same-force-stage maximum (Kw/n_i)*abs(Gk_i)/gamma in the additional necessary bound PoreDtSafety*h/u_k. These are necessary checks, not a sufficient variable-coefficient stability theorem.
